subject: PO ledger-tagging requirement and monthly billing window for HealthRise
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthrise.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: HealthRise AP <ap@healthrise.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields and monthly invoice cadence requirement

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealthRise is excited about Redwood. Before we can onboard, procurement needs to confirm a few billing requirements so our AP system will accept invoices:

- Every invoice must include a PO reference in the format HR-<entity>-<7 digit> (we will provide example PO values).
- Line-level ledger tags: we require a "BU Code" and "Cost Center" fields to appear on the invoice or an invoice attachment (our ERP uses those for automated GL posting).
- Invoice cadence: HealthRise policy prefers consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per vendor per month). We cannot process weekly invoices without additional approvals.
- Net terms: our standard is NET45. Can Redwood accept NET45 on initial SOWs?

Can you confirm if Redwood can (1) accept the PO format, (2) include the ledger fields as invoice metadata or a simple CSV attachment, and (3) bill on a monthly consolidated invoice with NET45 payment? If not, what compromises are possible?

If it helps, I've attached our PO template.

Regards,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthRise

--- attachment: HealthRise_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

----
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthrise.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields and monthly invoice cadence requirement

Hi Samantha — thanks, and great to hear HealthRise is moving forward. Short answers up front: yes on PO format, yes on including ledger tags, and we can accommodate monthly consolidated invoices. A couple of practical notes:

- PO reference: we can map the PO to our billing system and include the PO value on every invoice line. Please ensure the PO number is passed in the purchase order sent to accounting and on the invoice request form.

- Ledger tags: we typically add a one-line CSV attachment per invoice with BU Code and Cost Center. Our finance team prefers this rather than modifying invoice PDF layouts (easier for automated ingestion).

- Invoice cadence: Redwood's standard is to bill monthly for customers on annual or committed plans; for usage-based accounts we also support consolidated monthly statements. We can produce a single consolidated invoice covering all activity through month-end.

- Net terms: our standard public terms are NET30. For enterprise procurement we can offer NET45 with a small fee or a 1% surcharge to cover extended DSO, or alternatively NET30 with a 2% early-pay discount if HealthRise can move some payments up. Which is preferable?

I'll loop in Ben (billing) to confirm the CSV format and Vanessa for the contractual language.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

----
From: HealthRise AP <ap@healthrise.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthrise.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields and monthly invoice cadence requirement

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from AP:

- CSV attachment is acceptable; file should be named: HR_PO_<PO_NUMBER>_meta.csv and contain columns: PO, LineItemDesc, Amount, BU_Code, Cost_Center.
- Consolidated monthly invoice: we will provide one master PO per contract; AP needs invoices no later than 5 business days after month close to meet our cutoffs.
- Regarding terms: NET45 is our default. We cannot stretch to NET30. If Redwood requires NET30, we will need to request an exception internally which will delay onboarding.

Is Redwood able to confirm NET45 without a surcharge? If Redwood cannot, please provide written confirmation of the alternative (surcharge rate or early-pay discount) so we can route the paperwork.

Regards,
HealthRise AP Team

----
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthrise.com>, HealthRise AP <ap@healthrise.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields and monthly invoice cadence requirement

Hi Samantha / AP team — appreciate the clarity and the timeline. Internal check completed with Finance and Legal: we can accept NET45 for this engagement with no surcharge provided the account is on an annual commitment (or a 6+ month committed prepay plan). For purely month-to-month usage accounts we will require NET30 or a 1% processing surcharge if NET45 is required.

Action items and next steps:
- Tessa: I attached the signed SOW (Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf) for countersignature. This SOW references the annual commitment and billing cadence.
- Ben: will send the CSV template we will attach to invoices. Ben, please confirm the exact column names and whether we need a header row.
- Samantha: please confirm whether HealthRise will proceed with the annual commitment (so we can mark NET45/no-surcharge in the contract) or if you prefer month-to-month (we will outline the surcharge in an amendment).

We will also include an invoice delivery SLA: invoices for the previous month will be generated within 3 business days of month close and delivered to ap@healthrise.com; AP has 5 business days to process for their internal cutoffs.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf) — countersign requested.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick 15-min call if you want to finalize wording.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
